records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $164.1, or 8.6%, in the second quarter of 2025 when compared to the second quarter of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We experienced an increase in unit sales in the second quarter of 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The table below summarizes our absolute and full time equivalent (FTE; based on 40 hours per week) employee headcount, number of branch locations, number of $50K+ customer sites, and weighted Fastenal Managed Inventory (FMI) devices at the end of the periods presented and the percentage change compared to the end of the prior periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The impact of product pricing on net sales in the second quarter of 2025 was an increase of 140 to 170 basis points, in contrast to the second quarter of 2024, which experienced a decline of 30 to 60 basis points.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities increased $20.6 in the second quarter of 2025 when compared to the second quarter of 2024.
